_doc: Repo-only sizing data for shielded cables and SolderSleeve shield terminators (harness.design cable parts have no diameter field, https://docs.harness.design/feature/local-files/json-format). Cables are GENERIC by rule (HARNESS-CONSOLIDATION-AND-LAYOUT-PLAN 6.24); each generic part is sized against the Raychem (TE) 55PC shielded cable of the same core count and 20 AWG (Daniel's shelf cable: Raychem shielded, no drain wire; his harness.design library lists 55PC1213, 55PC1122, 55PC1133, 55PC1243). Values are from the TE SPECIFICATION CONTROL DRAWING of each family (linked per cable), in inches. jacket_in = the OUTSIDE DIAMETER UPPER SPEC LIMIT (worst case for 'jacket OD <= sleeve max'). shield_in is DERIVED, not printed on the sheets: the braid sits directly under the jacket, so shield OD = jacket inner diameter = OUTSIDE DIAMETER LOWER SPEC LIMIT - 2 x TARGET jacket WALL (worst case for 'shield OD >= sleeve min'). Replaces the earlier M27500 TG-14 / Harbour estimates (OPEN-ITEMS row 81, Daniel 2026-10-12). Gate: audit_solder_sleeves.py.

GENERIC SHLD CABLE 2C TP 20AWG.note: 55PC1122 has a silver-coated copper shield; the nickel-coated 55PC1223-20 is .135/.139/.144 in (jacket 3.66 mm), which also fits the same sleeve.

GENERIC SHLD CABLE 4C 20AWG.note: 55PC1243 has a wide OD tolerance (.150-.195 in); even the .173 in target (4.39 mm) is over the size-3 sleeve limit of 4.3 mm, so the 4-core needs size 4.

GENERIC SHLD CABLE 6C 20AWG.note: TE publishes no 55PC12x6 / 11x6 6-core sheet that opens as text; 55PC6291 is TE's 6-conductor shielded jacketed 600 V sheet (silver-coated copper shield, 55PC0114 wires). Source: https://www.mouser.lt/datasheet/3/2640/1/ENG_CD_55PC6291_A.pdf . Treat as the 6-core equivalent until a 55PC1x6x sheet is found.

sleeves._source: TE Connectivity SolderSleeve Shield Terminators catalog section 8 (5-1654025-5), https://www.te.com/commerce/DocumentDelivery/DDEController?Action=srchrtrv&DocLang=English&DocNm=5-1654025-5_sec8_SolderSleevShld_Trmntrs&DocType=CS - Table G (S200, 22 AWG M22759/91 lead, 200 C) and the M83519 table (S02, 20 AWG 55A0111 / M22759/32 lead, 150 C). Columns: Jacket OD Max, Shield OD Min (mm). A sleeve fits when the cable jacket OD <= max and the shield OD >= min.
